parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.description: The MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID).

parameters.name: SSID
parameters.description: The SSID in use for this BSS.

parameters.name: BlacklistAttempts
parameters.description: Number of times a Blacklist steer was attempted for this Access Point. Blacklist steering is the process of forcing a connected STA to move to another Access Point by temporarily blocking its access to the current Access Point.

parameters.name: BTMAttempts
parameters.description: Number of times a BTM (BSS Transition Management; 802.11k) steer was attempted for this Access Point.

parameters.name: BTMQueryResponses
parameters.description: Number of asynchronous BTM (BSS Transition Management; 802.11k) Queries for which a BTM Request was issued by this Access Point.
